data.name: Overboard
data.detailed_description:
Overboard is a Physics-Based Party Deck-builder. Fight your friends while discovering the oceans and characters of Overboard, unlocking new exciting power-ups, maps, and artwork along your journey.

In Development

This game is in early development! our dev team is working hard to deliver new exiting features before our demo releases, including but not limited to:

  • Online Player Hosting

  • CPU Boats

  • Map Interactables / Environmental Mechanics 

  • Power-Up TLC (Reworking power-up scaling and VFX)

  • Revamped Character Boats & Map Set Dressing

Couch Multiplayer Party Game

Battle in Free-For-All or Teams with up to 6 friends! 

Stack Chaotic Power-Ups

Build a crew of stacking power-ups to unleash powerful cannonball and dash attacks on your foes.

Unlock Charming Characters

Collect and Unlock a roster of unique characters from across the seas of Ambit, each one with a unique power-up and story.

data.short_description: Sink your friends with a power-up based crew of characters in this physics based party game. Collect and unlock characters to discover chaotic combinations to destroy your friends and become the best pirate captain on the seas.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3210 3.2 GHz / AMD A8-7600 APU 3.1 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 (Ivy Bridge) or AMD Radeon R5 series (Kaveri line) with OpenGL 4.4
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 2.5Ghz / Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics 640 / Apple M1 Chip
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, SteamOS 3.0, or equivalent 64-bit distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3210 3.2 GHz / AMD A8-7600 APU 3.1 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / AMD Radeon R5 series with OpenGL 4.4 or Vulkan 1.1 support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA / PulseAudio / PipeWire compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
